capabilities: Dims all but the focused line, sentence, paragraph or section
Pins granularity per note through frontmatter
Limits or excludes dimming by folder
Keeps lines with embeds, formulas and tables lit
Diagnoses why nothing is being dimmed
disambiguation: Not a theme or ambient-lighting plugin; it dims note text around the cursor.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer. Reading view is deliberately unsupported. Ships without default hotkeys. Interface text available in English, Chinese and Japanese.
problem: In a long note there is no visual cue for where you are working, so surrounding text competes with the line you are editing.

relations.evidence: Quiet panels, thin rules and small transitions share a visual rhythm with Scriptorium, Skill Switchboard and Collate.
